summary: Build practical supplier, Scope 3, and responsible sourcing skills in five days. Explore the sustainable supply chain management course.
lede: Sustainable supply chain training helps procurement and sustainability teams assess supplier impacts and plan responsible sourcing improvements. It is for procurement leaders, sourcing and logistics professionals, sustainability specialists, and supplier managers who need to screen risks, estimate Scope 3 emissions, review supplier evidence, and account for data quality. Learners practice building supplier scorecards, prioritizing corrective actions, and reporting progress through clear indicators and feasible improvement plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who influence supplier selection, supply chain performance, and sustainability evidence across purchasing and operations.
prerequisites: Prior experience in procurement, sourcing, supply chain, sustainability, or supplier management is recommended. Basic familiarity with supplier data and purchasing workflows will help you apply the exercises. No coding or programming is required.
